description: This Java source file defines utility functions for HTTP mode authentication in Apache Hive, including Kerberos ticket retrieval, cookie token creation and parsing, and GSS-API context handling.

classes.name: HttpAuthUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for Kerberos ticket retrieval, cookie token management, and GSS-API context creation for HTTP authentication.

classes.name: HttpAuthUtils.HttpKerberosClientAction
classes.description: Inner class implementing PrivilegedExceptionAction to establish a GSS-API context for Kerberos authentication.

methods.name: getKerberosServiceTicket
methods.description: Retrieves a Kerberos service ticket as a Base64-encoded string, either assuming the subject is already logged in or performing a JAAS login.

methods.name: createCookieToken
methods.description: Generates an unsigned cookie token containing the client username and a random number.

methods.name: getUserNameFromCookieToken
methods.description: Parses a cookie token string to extract the client username if valid.

methods.name: splitCookieToken
methods.description: Splits a cookie token string into attribute key-value pairs.
